arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Phillips argued the court of first instance lacks authority to order discovery.
Mr. Lynch argued emasculating section 1782 is not the proper way to respect comity concerns.
Mr. Minear agreed an interested party needs a pending proceeding.
Mr. Waxman argued section 1782 authorizes discovery for foreign or international tribunals.
